question: What name is given to placing a mantra at the beginning, end, and middle of a name?
premises: A mantra may be placed at the beginning of a name.
A mantra may be placed at the end and middle of a name.
This placement pattern has a technical name.
inference: Placing the mantra at the beginning, end, and middle of a name is called rodha.
plain_english: When the mantra is placed at the beginning, end, and middle of the name, it is called rodha.
